title: Support refreshing MCP tool, resources, etc lists and avoid prompts
author: lambertjosh
lessons: Fallback notification handlers that show raw JSON-RPC to users are a UX anti-pattern — log silently instead
MCP list_changed notifications are first-class spec features that clients must handle for dynamic capability servers
5.6:1 test-to-code ratio with handler map capture pattern is a clean approach for testing notification services
Vibe-coded PRs can still produce clean, well-tested implementations — judge the code, not the process description
